findings.location: source.html — multiple paragraphs containing embedded Scripture quotations (e.g. paragraph that begins "As Bible-believing Christians how shall we then live?" and later paragraphs quoting Revelation, Hebrews, 2 Corinthians, Matthew)
findings.source_quote:
And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet –Matthew 24:6.

…he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved –Matthew 24:13.

…the fearful, and unbelieving … [who] shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone… –Revelation 21:8.

He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son –Revelation 21:7.

Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account… –Hebrews 13:17.

For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad –2 Corinthians 5:10.

When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel –Matthew 8:10.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate each quoted Scripture passage into fluent, standard Korean while preserving the exact chapter:verse numbering and placement. For example: "And ye shall hear... –Matthew 24:6." should be rendered e.g. "또 전쟁과 전쟁의 소문을 들을 것이나 너희는 놀라지 말라 이런 일이 있어야 하되 끝은 아직 아니니라 — 마태복음 24:6." Apply the same approach for every quoted verse in the article, keeping verse references exactly (e.g. Matthew 24:6, Matthew 24:13, Revelation 21:8, Revelation 21:7, Hebrews 13:17, 2 Corinthians 5:10, Matthew 8:10). Do not leave the quoted Scripture text in English; the quotation must appear in Korean in the translation. Ensure the Korean conveys the printed English meaning (do not substitute a different Bible version wording beyond faithful rendering of the given English text). Replace the existing English scripture fragments inside <em> tags with the Korean translations while keeping the original HTML structure and tags unchanged.

Replace the English title "The Holy Bible" with a natural Korean rendering such as "성경" (or "거룩한 성경" if preserving the 'Holy' adjective is important in context). Preserve quotation marks and the surrounding HTML structure. Example replacement: "『성경』" or simply "성경" depending on house style, but do not leave the English title unaltered in the translated text.

findings.location: source.html — paragraph discussing "acts of God" (insurance companies)
findings.suggested_fix: Render the phrase fully in Korean rather than leaving the English in parentheses or mixing languages. The translation currently reads '‘하나님의 행위(acts of God)’'. Change to a single-language expression such as '「하나님의 행위」' or '하나님의 행위' so the reader sees a coherent Korean phrase. Keep meaning equivalent to the English idiom.
